info.title: OTInstaller Registry API
info.summary: The public registry of OSINT tools and guides that ot installs from.
info.description: Public reads need no sign-in and are cached at the edge (Cache-Control says for how long); every JSON read has an ETag, so If-None-Match gets a 304. Errors are {error: {code, message, hint, docs}} (https://otinstaller.com/schema/error-v1.json), with codes at https://otinstaller.com/docs/errors. 429s carry Retry-After. Signed-in calls take an ot_ token as a bearer token; each operation's x-scope names the scope a token needs. Times are Unix milliseconds. Guide: https://otinstaller.com/docs/api

post.summary: Upload a release (ot publish): the manifest, its README and pages, and their images
post.description: Needs a sign-in: the session cookie, or an API token with the publish scope, as an owner or publisher of the namespace. One part per file, the part named by the file's path relative to otinstaller.yaml (otinstaller.yaml itself included); at most 25 MB and 300 files. The release is then validated, scanned and reviewed as a tag is. At most 20 uploads an hour per namespace.

bearer.description: An ot_ API token from `ot login`, `ot token create` or POST /me/tokens. Tokens have scopes (x-scope on each operation); staff actions need the staff scope, which tokens get only when a signed-in reviewer or admin creates them on the website.

session.name: ot_session
session.description: The website's session (all of the user's powers)

RateLimited.description: Too many requests; retry after Retry-After seconds

Error.title: OTInstaller error, version 1
Error.description: The registry API's error body, and what ot prints on stderr (one line) when JSON output is on. Readers must ignore keys they don't know.

hint.description: What to do next, often an ot command.

exit_code.description: ot only: the exit code ot returns.

request_id.description: Identifies a failed registry request in its logs.

problems.description: Each problem with a manifest or request, most specific first.

notifies_target.description: Present only when the publisher says; unset on a tool that touches the target means it may

items.description: Usually one of the manifest's entity types

egress.description: Tools only: whether runs go online

health_checked_at.description: When the nightly health check last ran, in Unix milliseconds; null when never

sample.description: What the latest version's smoke test produced, when the scanner recorded it: up to five entities for json and jsonl tools, or the first 2000 characters of stdout. The input was the manifest's own test input.

manifest.description: The manifest without optional fields added after ot v0.12, which older ot rejects

manifest_full.description: The whole manifest; present only when `manifest` leaves fields out

descriptions.description: spec/types.json: what each input type, output (entity) type and category means

pivots.description: spec/pivots.json: entity type to the inputs it can feed

scoped.description: false for tokens from before scopes, which can do everything their user can

no_keys.description: Packages that need no API key
